description: This file implements the Widevine platform DRM handling, including constructor/destructor and decryption functions that interact with secure memory handling and external Widevine Cdm APIs.

classes.name: WidevinePlatformDRM
classes.description: A class providing DRM decryption services specific to Widevine platform, managing secure handle conversions and decrypt operations.

methods.name: WidevinePlatformDRM(widevine::Cdm * cdm)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Widevine platform DRM handler.

methods.name: ~WidevinePlatformDRM()
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up Widevine platform DRM resources.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const std::string & session_id,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Performs decryption using a handle and decryption batch, converting handles to secure pointers and invoking the widevine decrypt API.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Performs decryption with session ID, handle, and decryption batch, similar to the above but with session management.
